how_it_works_subtitle: Three simple steps to safeguard your legal food security entitlement
step_desc_1_text: Select your ration card category (Orange, Yellow, White, or AAY) to see your exact statutory grain quota.
step_desc_2_text: Enter the actual quantity of Wheat, Rice, and Sugar distributed to you at your Fair Price Shop (FPS).
step_desc_3_text: Generate a verified discrepancy audit report with auto reference number to submit to the Food Distribution Officer or call 1967.
rights_subtitle: Protected under the National Food Security Act & Government of Maharashtra PDS Regulations
right_1_desc: Every eligible household is legally guaranteed subsidised foodgrains every month without arbitrary refusal.
right_2_desc: The Fair Price Shop dealer must weigh grains on an electronic Point of Sale (ePoS) weighing scale accurately.
right_3_desc: Beneficiaries must pay strictly the government-fixed subsidised rate. Demanding excess commission is illegal.
right_4_desc: FPS must prominently display stock boards, retail prices, sample commodity bags, and vigilance committee lists.
right_5_desc: Immediate recourse via Toll-Free 1967 or the District Grievance Redressal Officer (DGRO) for shortages or corruption.
rule_item_1: Carry and produce your active ration card or linked Aadhaar biometric authentication at the FPS.
rule_item_2: Never pay more than the statutory government rate stamped on the cash memo receipt.
rule_item_3: Do not accept underweight bags or allow the dealer to deduct grain quantities on arbitrary grounds.
rule_item_4: Shop dealers cannot force you to buy non-PDS items (like soaps, tea, or salt) to get your grains.
rule_item_5: Demand a printed ePoS transaction slip for every transaction and report irregularities immediately.
helpline_card_desc: Report Fair Price Shop irregularities, biometric failures, overcharging, or distribution delays to the Food & Civil Supplies Department.
helpline_timing: Operational 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM (All working days)
faq_q1: What should I do if the ration dealer gives me less quantity than entitled?
faq_a1: Log your received amount in this portal, generate your Discrepancy Report, and immediately dial 1967 or submit the report to your local Tahsildar / Food Distribution Office.
faq_q2: Can the Fair Price Shop owner refuse ration if biometric verification fails?
faq_a2: No. Under Maharashtra PDS guidelines, if biometric failure occurs, alternative authentication through OTP on registered mobile or nominee verification must be facilitated.
faq_q3: Is there any charge for filing a ration shortage complaint?
faq_a3: No. Filing complaints through helpline 1967 or the public grievance portal is completely free of cost for all citizens.
